.. change::
    :tags: bug, batch
    :tickets: 1888

    Fixed bug in batch mode where an index created within
    :meth:`.Operations.batch_alter_table` that included SQL expressions, such
    as ``func.lower(column("name"))`` or ``column("name").desc()``, would be
    emitted against the plain column names alone when the table was
    recreated, silently producing a different index than the one specified;
    a :func:`~sqlalchemy.sql.expression.text` expression would raise a
    ``KeyError``.  Indexes created within the batch operation now retain
    their full expressions, in the same way as indexes that are already
    present on the table being recreated.
